# Code-review gate — withRetry diff

## Findings
1. [critical] The catch block swallows the error: after all attempts fail, callers get `null` with no signal — the original exception is silently lost. Rethrow the last error or return a Result type.
2. [major] The signature change Promise<T> -> Promise<T | null> silently breaks every existing caller that assumed a non-null resolution.
3. [minor] Retries fire immediately with no backoff; consider exponential delay for flaky I/O.

## Verdict: fail
The swallowed-error path changes the function contract and hides failures from callers; the diff must rethrow the final error (or return a typed Result) before it can pass.
